name: John Reif Memorial
where: Ithaca, NY · host Cornell · Moakley Course
headline: John Reif Memorial: No. 8 Syracuse men at Cornell
summary: No. 8 Syracuse men close their regular season Friday at Cornell's Moakley Course, with No. 30 Cornell men hosting the John Reif Memorial at 5:00 p.m. ET. Most ranked D-I teams are off before conference championships on Oct. 30–31.
